name: Walkthrough 5: Acoustic Voice Trigger in Machinery Roar
description: Heavy rescue concrete cutting saws and rubble excavators create intense 88-92 dB SPL acoustic noise. Demonstrates WakeNet sigmoid SNR margin evaluation and tactile button fallback.
